_note: Generic flag rules (docs/design/phase1-usability.md, section 4): applied after a project's own rules, to flags still open. match: maxRows, columns (each pattern must match a column name), table (pattern on the table name), all case-insensitive. A rule whose resolution keeps rows still needs a person's Yes. Add a rule only through review (pbik rules propose).

rules.why: a table loaded by a query gets made-up rows of the same shape
connections are never copied; the synthetic model has no source
roles aren't copied; the synthetic model has no roles
account, member and other entity tables get made-up values only
a small option table (a label and an order) keeps its labels and order; a person confirms them
